decisions: Shop uses flat editorial rows: two columns for the available launch pair and dividers, three columns for catalog and SS24 look rows, with no card chrome or gray image gutters.
Sold-out status replaces price text and purchase controls while keeping every garment detail page accessible.

The opening Products pair uses the supplied 5:7 portrait composition with a viewport-bounded card height; the first two SS24 looks use viewport-bounded 2:3 imagery and intentionally asymmetric copy spacing, then stack image before copy on mobile.
